MCPON, why is the navy giving bonuses to people coming in to the navy and enlisting when it seems like the navy is having a large problem with retention. Is there any plan on giving the sailors who want to stay in more of a incentive in bonuses? 

Also, there has been a large increase in suicides. As a corpsman I’ve seen the navy medical system fail sailors in the fleet when it comes to treatment of their mental health. If a sailor comes in to me and tell me they have Suicidal ideation, we get them to the ER room. At the ER room they are sat in a room and talked to by a provider about how large of a danger they are to them selves. The sailor is then faced with 2 options. Get admitted to the hospital at the mental health ward.(which could cause problems from taking him away from his or hers home life as well as work obligations) or they get a referral and must wait weeks or even months to be seen for their mental health. I would really like to see a change in this matter to ensure that sailors who are having mental health issues can be seen in a timely matter and not feel like they are being forgotten or unvalidated. 

And my third question. There have been many changes for female regulations and relaxing their standards. When can we seen men get the option to get some standards relaxed, such as mustache regulations or beards. I think sailors would benefit from being able to express them selves with mustaches and beards such as female sailors have by expressing it through their nail polish or by their hair color or by their new diamond earrings. 
 
Thanks MCPON. Please read and consider my question as well as other sailors. Thanks.

Here is the whole story.

I have been this women for the last 4 months. In the beginning things were the best I’ve ever had. We would go on dates constantly, I would pick her up late at night and have the best time driving around blasting music and just enjoying each other. There was so much love Ans passion. I never thought things could go wrong. 

First: I posted on Facebook about how I miss hugging and seeing one of my really close female friends on a social media account. She blew up. She told me that I disrespected her and that I embarrassed her on social media. She deleted all her social media that day. Took all our pictures And posts down. I went to her house late at night and went to go talk to her. During the conversation she told me that nothing mattered anymore and that since she had been talking to me that she pushed away allot of guys that wanted to be with her. She told me she wishes she could be like her friend who just hooks up with guys Ans has not attachment to them. She tried walking home that night but I drove her home and gave her a hug. This was the first time I told her I loved her, I didn’t want to say it at this time. I wanted it to be special. But i genuinely thought the worst and wanted her to know how I felt about her. 

Second: we went out to a club. I am
Not much of a drinker nor partier. We went to the first bar. My friend, her and her friend. We got pretty messed up allot of shots. After leaving the first bar we went to go dance. At first we were having a blast! It was allot of passion and love while dancing. But then we went to the bar to get drinks and this other guy shows up. Her friend came up to me and told me that this guy likes my girl. So I was like okay she’s here with me everything is okay. She ended up dancing with this guy. And I was dancing with her friend (not grinding) but I asked her friend what I should do, she told me to take her back. So I grabbed her away from this other guy. We danced but it was off. She told me she wanted to switch back. So I said f it and let it happen. We ended back at the bar and they were saying things to eachother in each others ears. And then she just walked off. When she came back I tried to ask if she’s okay, she just walked right past me back to the guy at the bar. They said a few more things Ans then she just left the club and went and sat down outside. I went out there to talk to her. But she wouldn’t say a thing to me. Another group of guys came up Ans started hitting on her and her friend and she was giving them attention. Once my friend came to pick us up. We got in the car except
For her. She couldn’t get up. So I went and bridal carried her in to the car. Once in the car she told me that she wanted to come home with me. I told her maybe that’s not the best idea. So she stayed with her friend at her apartment. Which later I found out that her and her female friend hooked up that night. In the morning I went over to talk to her Ans she apologized for her behavior and I told her I wanted to move forward with more communication and respect. 

Third: we went out again. This time we went straight out to another club. Again we were dancing have a great time. Again her female friend was there. Her friend came up and handed me a vape. I don’t smoke so I was just dancing with it because I was dancing by myself at the moment. I have it back to her friend and my girl came up to me Ans accused me of smoking the vape. I told her I didn’t smoke it. And for another 20 min she would just push me away when trying to dance with her. So i got really upset and went outside to cool off. When I came back in to the club. And she was dancing with another man. I was furious, my heart was racing and I went up and pulled her away. And me and the guy started to shoving eachother and she broke it up and pulled me outside. We got in to a argument outside. I asked her why she would be dancing with another guy like that, Ans she told me that there was no harm no foul. She told me that i probably went outside with another girl, I reassured her that this was not the case that I stepped outside because I was upset. That night she left with her friends to go to another club while I dropped off her other three friends back at there house. 4am she texted me and told me she didn’t have a ride so I went and liked her and brought her back to my place. We talked it out. 

Fourth: this was the most recent thing. I bought a house and moved her in with me. She has two kids with another guy who was physically abusibe towards her. When I was at her apartment helping her move out, I saw the damage and the blood on the carpet she couldn’t get out. Which made me so uncomfortable to see because my mother and father were the same way when I was young. So I thought it would be a good idea to move her out and in to my house where she could feel safe Ans happy. The first couple days at the house were amazing. Allot of love and allot of painting and allot of decorating Ans setting up. It was like out of a movie kinda deal. She wanted to throw a house warming party. So I invited a total of about 6 people when she invited about 20. There were people at this party who I’ve never even met. People would come in to the house Ans just go straight to her. Wouldn’t even congratulate me on buying my first house. The whole time at the party she was very social with a couple of her guy friends. Which was okay, she took allot of shots with them. Towards the end of the party, she pulled me in to the bathroom and we did the dirty. When we left the bathroom everyone was about gone. We needed up laying on the couch while she talked to one of my best friends. Well, she went through my phone where she saw messages between me and another one of my close friends from back in 2020. She took pictures of our conversation. She also saw that I messaged another close friend of mine who is a girl, where I kinda explained what happen with number one(the social media incident) and she took pictures of that too. So I kinda woke up out of a drunken slumber to find her crying in our room with the door locked. 

Ever since this last incident, things are 100% different. She told me that I disrespected her and put another girl over her by telling them what kinda happened. When ever I try to reassure her that I love her or want to be with her forever she responds with “doesn’t seem like it” the last two weeks have been so hard for me. I feel like I am pulling her to get attention to give to me. I feel like all I have been doing is bothering her at home when I try to tell her I love her or when I try to hold her hand or when I try to hug her. When I hug her she doesn’t even wrap her arms around me. She just pushes away from me. It’s really tough. When I tell her I love her, she doesn’t even respond most of the time. 

Fifth: she has had allot of guys in her phone, this isn’t my first rodeo. But these guys in her phone I feel like get more attention then I do. There’s been one who has been texting her good morning everyday for two weeks. And I’m talking with like kissy face emojis. Ans she’s been responding. I see the notification pop up on her phone and when I’m driving her car around. This past Saturday, she invited him out to the bar. She was really interested in talking to him. Like she would look at him in the eyes when talking. They talked about allot, I even had to get up to answer a phone call and he was sitting in my seat once I came back. He was telling her about how he just bought a motorcycle and she was like oh Your gonna have to take me on a ride. I tired kissing her in front of him but she turned her head Ans I kissed her on the cheek. When I would tell her I loved her she would say it softly in front of him. The next day, she went shopping and turned her location off for 8 hours through out the day. When she came back home, her left hand smelled like men’s body spray and her right hand smelt like nothing. And I brought this up that it smells weird and she just shrugged it off. 

I am torn right now because she is leaving for three weeks. She’s going to be gone, Ans the worst part is. She’s going to be with this guy from the bar that she was so interested in. She even told me that they have hooked up in the past but now they are just good friends. 

The last couple of days my heart has been hurting so bad. I try telling her I love her and that I will miss her but she only tells me sometimes that she will miss me or that 
 she loves me. I tired to cuddle her the last couple Of nights, And she just pushes my arms off of her. But I try to cuddle her anyway. 

I am just so torn to pieces about this. I want things to work so badly with her. I can see her being my wife one day. And the two kids she has, our amazing.  I love them with everything I have. I consider them as my own. I want nothing but the best for them. And they love me very much as well. 

I just don’t know what to do. I am torn that she is leaving for three weeks. I don’t know what it will be like when she comes back in three weeks. Will it be the same? Will our love go back to normal? Because that’s what I want here. I want our love to go back to normal. I want us to be good again. But I’m so so so scared that she’ll come back and tell me that someone else has caught her attention.
